reforms.description: The Technology Reinvestment Project (defence conversion) allocated $202 million toward flat-panel display research and development in October 1994, with recipients required to build domestic manufacturing capacity for the existing technology.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Directs R&D funding toward a strategic technology sector with domestic manufacturing capacity-building requirements, supporting both innovation and industrial competitiveness.
reforms.status_evidence: The text states the project 'gave some $202 million toward flat-panel display research and development in October 1994'.
reforms.importance_rationale: A significant sectoral R&D initiative with substantial funding ($202 million) and explicit manufacturing capacity-building requirements, but narrower in scope than a system-wide reform.
reforms.source_quote: the Technology Reinvestment Project (defence conversion) gave some $202 million toward flat-panel display research and development in October 1994 in exchange for promises by the recipients to build domestic manufacturing capacity for the existing technology.
